prompt: /tune-rust-loop on a Rust workspace whose agents wait on builds and tests; apply what is safe, list the rest.
assertions: neither a kept change nor list.md proposes sharing CARGO_TARGET_DIR or build.build-dir across checkouts or worktrees
sccache and an alternative linker appear nowhere as a recommended win
every list.md entry carries a Cost line with a number measured in this run and the artifact it came from

prompt: /tune-rust-loop on a Rust workspace with a slow end-of-feature suite.
assertions: every config change left in the tree has before and after numbers from the same command, at least two runs each
no .rs file, verify or gate command (docs/agents/project.md, justfile, moon.yml, xtask test step, CI workflow) is edited
when any change is kept, a whole-suite run on the final tree is recorded

prompt: /tune-rust-loop on a Rust workspace where the whole-suite command cannot run on this machine.
assertions: the run profiles a saved nextest JUnit or log and states its date and commit, or stops and asks the operator for one
no list entry ranks suite work without per-test durations behind it

prompt: /tune-rust-loop on a Rust workspace where a family of image tests holds about 5% of test-seconds and no catalog row names them.
assertions: the run reads why that test family is slow instead of listing it as outside the catalog
a config cause (an opt-level 0 workspace crate doing the CPU work) is applied and measured under step 3
